title: Neural Quadratic Forms: A Unified Minimal Model for Sudden Learning and Scaling Laws
abstract: arXiv:2608.13335v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neural networks trained by gradient descent on a smooth cost function can nevertheless learn in steps: the cost holds on long plateaus and then drops abruptly. Meanwhile, training losses instead follow smooth power laws. Variants of both behaviors occur in architectures with very different microscopic structures, which is the signature of a few relevant collective variables. We show that a symmetry fixes what those variables are: a network layer is a sum over interchangeable units, so relabeling the units leaves it unchanged; given smoothness and the condition that a unit's gradient vanish at the origin, symmetry then enforces a universal leading form for the expansion about the near-zero weights present at the start of training, the quadratic $\Tr[WW^{\top}A(x)]$, in which every architectural detail is confined to a single ``structure matrix" $A(x)$ that we compute for each architecture. translated_title: 神经二次型：突发学习与尺度定律的统一最小模型
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13335v1 公告类型：新 摘要：通过梯度下降在光滑代价函数上训练的神经网络仍可能以阶梯方式学习：代价在长平台上保持，然后突然下降。与此同时，训练损失却遵循平滑的幂律。这两种行为的变体出现在微观结构差异很大的架构中，这是少数相关集体变量的标志。我们证明，对称性决定了这些变量是什么：网络层是多个可互换单元的和，因此重新标记单元不会改变它；给定光滑性以及单元梯度在原点处消失的条件，对称性强制规定了训练开始时近零权重附近展开的通用主导形式，即二次型 $\Tr[WW^{\top}A(x)]$，其中所有架构细节都被限制在一个我们为每个架构计算的单一“结构矩阵”$A(x)$中。感知机、注意力层、专家混合层等均适用。
tldr: 本文提出一个统一的最小模型，基于对称性推导出神经网络在训练初期近零权重附近的主导二次型形式，将突发学习和尺度定律归因于一个通用的结构矩阵，适用于感知机、注意力层等多种架构。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified minimal model showing that symmetry enforces a universal quadratic form near zero weights in neural networks, confining architecture details to a single structure matrix, explaining both sudden learning and scaling laws across various architectures.
